goblin-scrounger: If it glows, it's his. If it doesn't, he'll lick it until it does.
goblin-scrapper: He has never won a fight fairly. He has never lost one either.
goblin-slinger: Free shipping, mostly because nobody wants the skulls back.

goblin-grunt: He has a bucket for a helmet and a plan for nothing.

junk-shaman: The spirits speak in rattles and an occasional 'clang'.

clockwork-beetle: Wind it up and run. Not necessarily in that order.
gnome-illusionist: The rabbit was never real. The bill, however...
gyrocopter-ace: Flies low, fast and slightly sideways.
the-great-steam-golem: Please keep fingers, beards and cats away from the valve.

gnome-cogger: A very small cog. But an important one.
gnome-widget: Nobody knows what it does. It does it very well.
hexwright-apprentice: Page two was stuck to page three. It went fine.
gearward-sentinel: Politely asks you to leave. Then impolitely.
runic-siphoner: Borrowing is such an ugly word.
phase-stalker: Blink and you'll miss him. Blink again and he's behind you.

shieldbeard: Mostly the beard. The shield is a backup.
axe-thrower: Always has one more axe. Always.

meteor-strike: Aim for the biggest problem. Hit the biggest problem.
healing-light: Tastes faintly of mint and bandages.
fizzle: The spell sputters, coughs and gives up.
hold-it: Time out. For everyone but you.
spell-snap: Your spell, my spell, same spell.
mirror-hex: Have you tried not casting that?
